_about: Official files this repo's data is built from. scripts/refresh_sources.py downloads them (monthly in GitHub Actions, because the dev sandbox cannot reach these hosts), records sha256 in sources/fetched.json, and opens a pull request when something is new or changed. 'kind: links' crawls an index page, so a new amendment or tool version appears as a new file without editing this file. confirmed:false means the URL was inferred, not seen: the first run reports if it is wrong. 'build' lists importer scripts to run when the entry changes (skipped, and reported, until written). Large reference sets (FDA's NDC directory and UNII list) are not here: committing them monthly would bloat git; add them with artifact storage when the OTC phase needs them.

entries.name: FDA SPL Implementation Guide with Validation Procedures (current)
entries.note: FDA keeps this media id pointing at the current guide. A change means a new revision: diff it against sources/spl_ig_vp_dec_2023.pdf (chapters 2, 3.4, 35, 36 for cosmetics; 4 onward for OTC drug listing).

entries.name: FDA SPL resources page: schema, stylesheet, guides, code lists
entries.note: A new schema or stylesheet bundle: replace the copies under data/spl_schema/ and data/spl_stylesheet/ and re-run tests/test_schema.py.

entries.name: FDA cosmetics registration and listing page: guidance, category list, forms
entries.note: A new guidance revision can change Appendix A (the category codes): point scripts/build_cosmetic_categories.py at it and re-run.

entries.name: ESG NextGen user guides (API guide and specification, USP guide)
entries.note: Confirmed 2026-10-15: the crawl finds the API guide and specification, the USP guide, the AS2 guide and the passkey guide. Check endpoints, headers, request bodies and error codes in esg.py against the new specification.
